title: Give ideas a place.
brief: A fictional collaborative design workspace concept.
headline:
Give ideas
a place.
scene: Pale lavender background with one oversized angled white creative-canvas window on right. On the canvas: an original composition of coral sphere, cobalt arch and yellow stepped blocks. Three small floating tool chips labeled exactly Shape, Colour, Share. A neat black cursor arrow beside a corner. Large black condensed headline left and small FORMKIT wordmark. Premium product art, tactile clay meets crisp interface, no unreadable microtext.
